title: Why Mosquitoes Always Find You First
caption:
Why do mosquitoes ALWAYS find you first?
One cartoon guy gets swarmed by hungry mosquitoes, then a radar scan reveals exactly how they lock onto him.
Key fact: mosquitoes track the CO2 you breathe out and your body heat like guided missiles.
Are you always the one getting bitten at every BBQ?
Save this for your next outdoor dinner and follow for more daily facts.
